note: Layered hero colours (docs/character-appearance-layered-spec.md). Index = CharacterAppearanceData.hairColorIndex / outfitColorIndex: never reorder, only append (saved characters keep their index; CharacterAppearanceData.HairColorCount / OutfitColorCount must match). Each colour is the BASE tone (#999999 grey of the art); HeroRecolor.shader and Tools/hero_recolor_core.py build the dark and light tones from it.
